verdict.rationale: The RTX 5070 Ti product page documents NVIDIA Project G-Assist, an AI assistant running on the RTX PC that helps users tune, control and optimize their system, so the card's own ecosystem offers an assistant-driven way to operate it. However, the evidence never explicitly says G-Assist takes natural-language commands, does not say which controls it covers, and the 'Project' label suggests it may be an early or experimental feature. missing for 10: explicit documentation of natural-language command input, scope of controllable GPU settings, hands-on or independent corroboration, clarity on production status.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: NVIDIA Project G-Assist is an AI assistant powered by your GeForce RTX PC that helps you tune, control, and optimize your system.
